author: Kif Leswing
title: Trump just threatened to place tariffs on the iPhone and Apple stock is getting crushed (AAPL)
text: Trump just threatened to place tariffs on the iPhone and Apple stock is getting crushed (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Nov 26, 2018, 4:47 pm 21 pts Trump said in an interview with the Wall Street Journal that he could put a 10% tariff on iPhones and Chinese electronic goods. Apple's stock fell in after hours trading following the remarks. President Donald Trump has threatened to put a 10% tariff on the iPhone and other consumer electronics, and…
